rationale: Civil engineering draftsperson role: preparing and amending civil and structural drawings in AutoCAD or Revit, updating them for site conditions and making site visits, which matches Marc's Advanced Diploma drafting in AutoCAD and Civil 3D and his Philippines site work.
An Advanced Diploma or Engineering Drafting qualification is accepted, and Marc also holds a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering.
Miranda in southern Sydney, so relocation would be needed; the advert asks for at least 3 years of civil or structural drafting experience, mostly on building projects.
caution: The 3 year drafting experience minimum is well above Marc's study based drafting; building (residential and commercial) focus rather than roads and drainage; Sydney move for Marc to confirm.
